stem: A hospital compares its infection-rate performance with national or peer-organization data to identify opportunities for improvement. What is this process called?
rationale: AHRQ defines benchmarking as evaluating metrics or best practices from other organizations and applying the comparison to identify potential solutions, achievable quality levels and areas for improvement. Therefore A is correct. Surveillance focuses on ongoing monitoring, credentialing verifies professional qualifications, and utilization review evaluates the appropriateness or necessity of services rather than peer-performance comparison.
educational_objective: Identify benchmarking as comparison with external metrics or peer practices to guide quality improvement.
source_organization: Agency for Healthcare Research and Quality (AHRQ) Digital Healthcare Research
source_version_date: Current AHRQ Digital Healthcare Research resource as accessed 2026-08-16
source_locator: Description/Uses — evaluating metrics or best practices from other organizations; determine possible quality level and areas that can be improved.
source_claim_supported: Comparing local performance with peer/national metrics to identify improvement opportunities is benchmarking.

blueprint_locator: Management of Care — Performance Improvement/Quality Improvement.

source_original.stem: A hospital compares its infection-rate performance with national or peer-organization data to identify opportunities for improvement. What is this process called?
source_original.rationale: Benchmarking compares an organization's performance measures or practices with external standards or peer organizations to identify improvement opportunities, so Option A is correct. Surveillance is ongoing data collection and monitoring, credentialing verifies professional qualifications, and utilization review evaluates the appropriateness or necessity of services rather than peer performance comparison.
source_original.source_detail: AHRQ Digital Healthcare Research — Benchmarking: benchmarking evaluates metrics and/or best practices from other organizations or reference standards and compares them with local performance to identify opportunities for improvement. Current AHRQ benchmarking workflow-assessment resource live-rechecked 2026-08-15. NCLEX relevance independently verified against the 2026 NCSBN Management of Care performance-improvement activities.
